title: Resident Handbook — Pets in Independent Living Apartments: Fees and Limits
content:
Residents under an Independent Living Residency Agreement may register pets within the limits of their apartment type. Registration carries a one-time fee per pet and a monthly fee per registered pet.

| Apartment type | One-time pet fee (per pet, non-refundable) | Monthly pet fee (per registered pet, per calendar month) | Maximum registered pets | Maximum adult weight of a registered dog |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 450.00 | 35.00 | 1 | 25 lb |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 450.00 | 35.00 | 1 | 25 lb |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 450.00 | 40.00 | 2 | 35 lb |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 450.00 | 40.00 | 2 | 35 lb |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 450.00 | 45.00 | 2 | 35 lb |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 450.00 | 0.00 | 2 | 60 lb |

## Questions on the table

**Is there a monthly pet fee in a Cottage Home?** The monthly pet fee for the Independent Living Cottage Home is 0.00; the one-time pet fee of 450.00 per pet still applies on registration.

**Can a Studio household register two pets?** No. The Studio and the One-Bedroom permit one registered pet; the Deluxe apartments, the Two-Bedroom and the Cottage Home permit two.

**What does the weight limit measure?** The maximum adult weight of a registered dog, in pounds: 25 for the Studio and One-Bedroom, 35 for the One-Bedroom Deluxe, Two-Bedroom and Two-Bedroom Deluxe, and 60 for the Cottage Home.

Hypothetical example: a household in an Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe with two registered cats has a monthly pet fee of 45.00 per pet, 90.00 for the month.
